blogs.title: Multiphasic Anaphylaxis: When One Treatment Isn’t Enough – Navigating the Unknown
blogs.description: This post delves into the confusing world of multiphasic anaphylaxis, where patients experience multiple relapses after initial stabilization. It reviews epidemiology, unclear risk factors, and challenges in distinguishing true biphasic reactions from sustained anaphylaxis or delayed allergen absorption. The article proposes a practical framework for risk stratification, when to admit to ICU, and how a multidisciplinary approach can improve outcomes. It calls for a national registry to build evidence for tailored monitoring protocols.

blogs.title: Epinephrine Dosing Dilemma: 0.3 mg vs 0.5 mg – Does the Auto‑Injector Choice Matter?
blogs.description: A deep dive into the most common epinephrine dosage dilemma in practice. We dissect the 0.01 mg/kg recommendation, the difference between 0.3 mg auto‑injectors and 0.5 mg adult devices, and the evidence that the lower dose is linked with more subsequent epinephrine requirement in multiphasic events. Practical advice for selecting, advocating, and training staff on the correct device is offered, with implications for both pre‑hospital and in‑hospital settings.

blogs.title: Corticosteroids in Anaphylaxis: Myth vs Reality – Should We Still Be Giving Them?
blogs.description: In light of recent systematic reviews and guideline updates, this article answers the question: do steroids truly prevent biphasic anaphylaxis? We summarize the evidence showing no benefit and potential harm, discuss timing and indications where a steroid may still be considered, and propose a decision tree to help clinicians choose the right approach. We also highlight the impact on resource use—especially ICU admissions.

blogs.title: Systemic Mastocytosis and Anaphylaxis: A Hidden Link You Need to Know
blogs.description: This post highlights how systemic mastocytosis can manifest as severe, multiphasic anaphylaxis. Using the case as a springboard, we review WHO diagnostic criteria, the role of baseline and peak tryptase, and the long‑term management strategy that includes high‑dose antihistamines and avoidance education. Readers will learn how to suspect mastocytosis early, negotiate appropriate referrals, and tailor monitoring.

blogs.title: Tryptase Timing and Interpretation: Lessons from a Multiphasic Anaphylaxis Case
blogs.description: Proper timing of serum tryptase measurement is essential but frequently missed. This article outlines recommended sampling windows, explains why delays can miss peak elevations, and how persistent elevation indicates systemic mastocytosis. A step‑by‑step algorithm is presented for when to order, interpret, and follow up on tryptase levels during an anaphylactic event.
